newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo corn futures plunge across the board.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo corn futures plunge across the board.

text.p: All Tokyo corn futures plunged by their daily limit of 400 yen per tonne on Friday, as active long liquidation from local investors emerged, traders said.
The most-active benchmark January 1998 contract ended at 15,690 yen. The estimated daily volume was 112,539 lots.
The Chicago market's price falls overnight triggered heavy selling by local investors, traders said. "Investors also thought price rallies yesterday were excessive," a brokerage house trader said.
On Thursday, all Tokyo corn futures surged by their daily limit, backed by sharp gains in soybean futures, traders said.
